text: My name is Viviana Longoria, and it has been one of the greatest honors to serve as your Councilwoman for District 4.

El Monte is more than my hometown; it is where I grew up, attended our local schools, married my high school sweetheart, raised my three children, and now have the joy of watching my grandchildren create their own memories. This community has shaped my life, and I am committed to ensuring it continues to be a place where every family can thrive.

As Mayor, I will work to make El Monte safer, cleaner, and stronger. I will continue collaborating with our school districts, city staff, businesses, and organizations to support children and families, and improve quality of life for every resident. I will also work to attract quality restaurants, shopping, and entertainment so families can enjoy more activities close to home. A stronger local economy creates jobs, improves city services, and strengthens our community.
Public safety will remain a priority because every resident deserves to feel safe and proud of the community they call home. Together we will build El Monte's future.
Today, I humbly ask for your vote to become the next Mayor of El Monte.

text: My name is Christine Sarmiento, a Public Health Nurse and Operations Manager raising five boys and a proud resident of El Monte. I immigrated to the US at eighteen and have lived in different parts of California. No other city compares to El Monte. El Monte has so much hidden potential, the same way many immigrants do. We work hard, we build quietly, and it takes time to fully realize what we are capable of. I want to help El Monte create real opportunities for our residents to achieve their potential.

I see that same potential in my own five boys, and it's why I decided to give back to the city that raised me. As a nurse, I care for our community's physical and psychological health. As an operations manager, I turn plans into real results. El Monte is home to young families, yet we have just 1% of our land as parkland, crime above the national average, and streets that need repair.
I am asking for your help in getting your vote as your new Mayor, to create a space that promotes health and safety for our kids, our families, and all the residents of El Monte.
